{
  "decisions": [
    {
      "decision": "balance_constraint_sign_convention",
      "evidence": "\"Each city must maintain a balance between incoming and outgoing resources. City 0 must ensure that the total resources it sends out are balanced by the resources it receives from other cities. City 1 has a net demand of 1 unit, City 2 has a net surplus of 2 units...\"",
      "options": [
        "inflow - outflow == net_demand (demand positive)",
        "outflow - inflow == net_demand (demand positive)",
        "inflow - outflow == -net_demand (surplus positive)"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.45,
        0.45,
        0.1
      ],
      "majority_option": "inflow - outflow == net_demand (demand positive)"
    },
    {
      "decision": "incoming_capacity_direction",
      "evidence": "\"Each city has a maximum capacity for handling incoming resources. City 0 can receive up to 16 units...\"",
      "options": [
        "sum of inflow <= in_cap[k]",
        "sum of inflow >= in_cap[k]",
        "sum of inflow == in_cap[k]"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.95,
        0.03,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "sum of inflow <= in_cap[k]"
    },
    {
      "decision": "route_capacity_direction",
      "evidence": "\"The route from City 0 to City 1 can handle up to 7 units of resources...\"",
      "options": [
        "x[i,j] <= route_cap[i,j]",
        "x[i,j] >= route_cap[i,j]",
        "x[i,j] == route_cap[i,j]"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.97,
        0.02,
        0.01
      ],
      "majority_option": "x[i,j] <= route_cap[i,j]"
    },
    {
      "decision": "variable_domain",
      "evidence": "\"The amount of resources transported between any two cities cannot be negative.\"",
      "options": [
        "NonNegativeReals",
        "NonNegativeIntegers",
        "Binary"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.85,
        0.14,
        0.01
      ],
      "majority_option": "NonNegativeReals"
    },
    {
      "decision": "objective_definition",
      "evidence": "\"The objective is to determine the optimal amount of resources to transport between cities to minimize the total transportation cost\"",
      "options": [
        "minimize sum c[i,j]*x[i,j] over all arcs",
        "minimize total shipped volume sum x[i,j]",
        "minimize sum c[i,j]*x[i,j] plus penalty on inflow"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.95,
        0.04,
        0.01
      ],
      "majority_option": "minimize sum c[i,j]*x[i,j] over all arcs"
    },
    {
      "decision": "demand_satisfaction_encoding",
      "evidence": "\"City 1 has a net demand of 1 unit, City 2 has a net surplus of 2 units...\" and \"Each city must maintain a balance between incoming and outgoing resources.\"",
      "options": [
        "net demand/surplus enforced exactly via equality balance constraints",
        "net demand enforced as inflow >= demand (inequality), surplus as outflow >= surplus",
        "demand satisfied only through incoming capacity limits"
      ],
      "plausibility": [
        0.9,
        0.08,
        0.02
      ],
      "majority_option": "net demand/surplus enforced exactly via equality balance constraints"
    }
  ]
}
